name: Why do I need design coordination for my home remodel?

mainEntity.name: Why do I need design coordination for my home remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Design coordination is crucial for complex remodels, especially those involving structural changes or multiple specialists. It prevents costly errors and delays by ensuring all professionals are working from the same, unified plan. Without coordination, discrepancies between design documents and construction realities can emerge, leading to rework, budget overruns, and compromised results. It streamlines communication and keeps the project on track, delivering a finished product that truly reflects your design intent.
acceptedAnswer.description: Design coordination prevents errors and delays in complex remodels by ensuring all professionals work from a unified plan, saving time and money.
